eps.ov: Five girls dressed in classical maid outfits wake up in a windowless mansion.
eps.oa: تفيق خمس فتيات في ثياب خادمات كلاسيكية في قصر بلا نوافذ.

eps.ov: In her tenth game, Yuki becomes frustrated when the other players refuse to heed her advice.
eps.oa: في لعبتها العاشرة تضيق «يوكي» حين يرفض اللاعبون الآخرون الأخذ بنصيحتها.

eps.ov: Mishiro refuses to admit her mistake and leads the others into harm's way.
eps.oa: ترفض «ميشيرو» أن تعترف بخطئها، فتقود الأخريات إلى الأذى.

eps.ov: The players reach the finish line, but they must complete a final trial before they can leave.
Yuki wakes up late to a game already in progress.
In a garden reminiscent of a forest and wearing a bunny outfit, Yuki wakes up to artificial woodland sounds.
Moegi tries to lead her stump team full of beginners, but they fall one after another to the veteran rabbits.
The rabbits flee from the approaching bloodthirsty killer.
Yuki easily defeats Moegi, but Moegi's death fills Yuki's mind with doubt.
